title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: Dow, Nasdaq jumps 1% as pause in US-Iran hostilities lifts sentiment - The Economic Times
text:
Dow Jones Today | US Stock Market Live: US market's main indexes opened higher on Monday after the United States and Iran paused hostilities, lifting risk appetite ahead of a busy week of corporate earnings, economic data and an interest-rate decision.

The tech-heavy Nasdaq is down 8% from its record high, while earlier this month the Philadelphia SE Semiconductor Index confirmed it has been in "bear market" territory since late June.
